description: A granted or published patent document issued by a patent office (e.g., USPTO, EPO, WIPO), characterized by a unique patent number, an invention title, named inventors, and an assignee; excludes pending applications, design patents' visual galleries, and legal-status news articles about patents.
examples: Method and system for distributed ledger consensus using asynchronous Byzantine fault tolerance
Wireless power transfer apparatus for electric vehicle charging stations
Adaptive noise-canceling earbud with biometric authentication

fields.name: title
fields.description: Official invention title as displayed in the patent header or 'Bibliographic Data' section
fields.example: Method and system for distributed ledger consensus using asynchronous Byzantine fault tolerance

fields.name: patent_number
fields.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by the patent office, usually in the document header with prefix like US, EP, WO, GB, DE, JP, CN, KR

fields.name: inventors
fields.description: Names of the named inventors, typically listed in the 'Bibliographic data' block separated by semicolons or commas, sometimes with residence city/country

fields.name: assignee
fields.description: Entity (company or person) to whom the patent rights are assigned, shown next to 'Applicant' or 'Assignee' in the bibliographic data

fields.name: filing_date
fields.description: Date the application was filed, labeled 'Filing date' or 'Date of filing' in the bibliographic data, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD or DD MMM YYYY

fields.name: publication_date
fields.description: Date the patent was granted or published, labeled 'Publication date', 'Issued on', or 'Date of publication', formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: abstract
fields.description: Short paragraph summarizing the invention, typically the first paragraph on the patent page under the heading 'Abstract'
fields.example: A consensus mechanism for distributed ledger networks that tolerates asynchronous Byzantine failures by partitioning node roles into...

fields.name: ipc_classification
fields.description: International Patent Classification codes shown as strings such as 'H04L 9/00' or 'G06F 17/00', grouped under 'IPC' or 'Classification' on the page

fields.name: document_url
fields.description: Link to the full patent PDF or original filing page, labeled 'Download PDF', 'Full document', or shown as the 'Espacenet' / 'Google Patents' canonical URL
